outputs.visual_description_en: A close-up image of a crowd of people, predominantly Indian, in what appears to be an indoor setting. In the foreground, a woman with dark hair, wearing a yellow top and a light green dupatta, is captured mid-expression with her mouth open, possibly yawning or shouting, and her right hand raised to her mouth. She has a red bindi on her forehead and a ring on her finger. To her left, a man with glasses and a beard is partially visible. In the background, other individuals are seen, some with arms raised, suggesting a celebratory or excited atmosphere. The BBC News logo is visible in the bottom left corner.
